scene: Day 90, depot yard at the street gate. Patch (white round head, orange bandage above his right eye) is squeezed flat in the narrow slot between the open sliding gate panel and the depot wall, orange backpack clutched to his chest, eyes wide, one sweat drop. A dense river of green walkers streams through the open gateway a hand's width from his face, with the yard behind them packed all the way to the canopy, the beige coach half buried in the crowd and the loudspeaker horn blaring under the solar panel. Tense because a single turned head would find him.

Day 90, the street outside the depot at dusk. Patch stands alone in the road, mouth wide open in a shout, orange backpack on, as every green walker in the street and in the gateway turns toward him, the walker in the ragged olive-gray vest at the front. Behind him the heavy sliding gate is closing, with Nora's arm and purple band visible in the last gap as she pushes it shut. Tense because he is on the wrong side of the gate and she is locking him out on purpose.
